claim.claim-text: 1. A clothes care apparatus (1) comprising:
a main body(10) including a clothes care room (11); and a steam generating device (30) provided to supply steam into the clothes care room, wherein the steam generating device includes:

2. The clothes care apparatus of claim 1, wherein the wash liquid discharging part includes a second pump (200) provided to discharge the wash liquid having cleaned the scale to an outside of the steam container.
3. The clothes care apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a sump (65) provided to accommodate the wash liquid having cleaned the scale that is discharged from the second pump.
4. The clothes care apparatus of claim 1, wherein the wash liquid discharging part includes:

a third pump (131) connected to the sump to drain the wash liquid having cleaned the scale; and a drain container (15a) configured to accommodate the wash liquid having cleaned the scale that is discharged from the third pump.
5. The clothes care apparatus of claim 2, wherein the second pump further includes a valve.
6. The clothes care apparatus of claim 2, wherein the second pump is arranged at a position lower than a position of the steam container.

7. The clothes care apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a connecting pipe(220) connecting the steam container to the second pump, wherein the connecting pipe connects a lower portion of the steam container to at least a portion of the second pump.
8. The clothes care apparatus of claim 1, wherein the wash liquid injecting part includes:
a supply water container (15b) provided to supply water to the steam container; a first pump (111) provided to move the wash liquid introduced into the supply water container to the steam container;
a first connecting member (117) connecting the first pump to the steam container; and a first valve (114) provided on a path of the first connecting member.
9. The clothes care apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a water level sensor (300) configured to detect an amount of water in the steam container.
10. The clothes care apparatus of claim 9, further comprising:

an inputter (600); and a controller (500) configured to, upon determining that the scale is generated on the water level sensor by comparing a reference sensor value corresponding to a predetermined clothes care course with an output signal of the water level sensor, control the wash liquid injecting part and the wash liquid discharging part to discharge the wash liquid through the steam container based on a user command received through the inputter.

11. The clothes care apparatus of claim 10, wherein the controller, when an amount of change in the output signal is less than a predetermined value and water is introduced into the steam container based on an output signal of another sensor included in the clothes care apparatus, determines that the scale is generated on the water level sensor.

12. The clothes care apparatus of claim 10, wherein the controller, upon determining that water exists in the steam container based on the output signal at a time point when a predetermined time has elapsed since steam is supplied into the clothes care room, determines that the scale is generated on the water level sensor.

13. The clothes care apparatus of claim 10, wherein the controller, upon determining that the scale is generated on the water level sensor, heats the wash liquid through the heating part based on the user command.
14. The clothes care apparatus of claim 13, wherein the controller heats the wash liquid through the heating part for a predetermined time.
15. The clothes care apparatus of claim 11, wherein the controller, in response to a temperature of the wash liquid being exceeding a predetermined temperature, stops discharging the wash liquid.
